errors.evidence: The description provides a few examples of categories with high and low values (0, 7, 8, 9) but completely omits any mention of the 12 categories that have values of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6. This is more than half of the data points and gives an incomplete representation of the data distribution.
When listing examples of categories with a value of 0, the description omits one of the four categories, which is "резюме на публикацията (abstract) на друг език".
The category label in the chart is "афилиация", not "афилизация". This is a spelling error.

The chart label is "резюме на публикацията (abstract) и на англ. ез.". The phrase "и на" means "and in" or "as well", implying this is in addition to another language. The description simplifies this to "in English", losing the original nuance.
